name: Amorebieta-Etxano (Spain)
description: Dark red field charged at the centre with the full achievement of the arms of Amorebieta-Etxano within a wreath, inscribed ZORNOTZA.
history: Municipal flag of Amorebieta-Etxano; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Amorebieta-Etxano arms — quartered, within a wreath, inscribed ZORNOTZA
